description: Synthetic, hand-authored task recurrence cases for testing whether RSI retrieves the intended approved lesson. This is not a production task-quality benchmark.

records.title: Preserve leading zeros in identifiers
records.lesson: Load identifier-like CSV columns as strings before schema inference.
applicability: Numeric-looking SKU, account, or catalog identifiers
records.evidence: A regression fixture kept 000184 unchanged.

records.title: Decode Excel CSV byte-order marks
records.lesson: Use utf-8-sig when an Excel-exported CSV may contain a byte-order mark.
applicability: The first header contains invisible characters or mojibake
records.evidence: The header parsed correctly after BOM-aware decoding.

records.title: Canonical JSON for stable snapshots
records.lesson: Sort object keys and use fixed separators before snapshotting JSON output.
applicability: Snapshots change only because map insertion order differs
records.evidence: Repeated runs produced byte-identical fixtures.

records.title: Retry writes only with idempotency protection
records.lesson: Retry a mutating HTTP request only when it carries an idempotency key or has equivalent deduplication.
applicability: POST or payment calls can time out after the server commits
records.evidence: An idempotency key prevented duplicate orders during timeout retries.

records.title: Advance cursor pagination from server tokens
records.lesson: Use the returned next cursor verbatim and stop when it is absent.
applicability: An API exposes opaque cursor pagination
records.evidence: The client stopped skipping rows after removing locally computed cursors.

records.title: Cancel stale React search requests
records.lesson: Abort the previous request when a new search term starts and ignore late responses.
applicability: Fast input causes older network responses to overwrite newer results
records.evidence: A delayed-response test no longer replaced the newest search results.

records.title: Use half-open UTC database ranges
records.lesson: Convert boundaries to UTC and query timestamps with an inclusive start and exclusive end.
applicability: Daily reports cross time zones or daylight-saving transitions
records.evidence: Boundary fixtures stopped double-counting midnight events.

records.title: Isolate filesystem tests with pytest tmp_path
records.lesson: Build files under pytest's tmp_path fixture and pass paths into the unit under test.
applicability: Tests create, mutate, or delete local files
records.evidence: Parallel test runs stopped sharing stale artifacts.

records.title: Match container UID for bind mounts
records.lesson: Run the development container with a host-compatible UID and GID when writing bind-mounted files.
applicability: Docker creates root-owned build output on the host
records.evidence: Generated artifacts became editable by the host user.

records.title: Detect page rotation before OCR
records.lesson: Normalize each PDF page rotation before optical character recognition.
applicability: Scanned pages are sideways or have inconsistent orientation metadata
records.evidence: Word accuracy improved on rotated scan fixtures.

records.title: Use yuv420p for broad video playback
records.lesson: Encode delivery MP4 files with a yuv420p pixel format when compatibility matters.
applicability: A rendered video plays locally but fails in browsers or presentation software
records.evidence: The converted asset played in all target clients.

records.title: Configure a CJK-capable plotting font
records.lesson: Select an installed CJK font explicitly before rendering Chinese chart labels.
applicability: Matplotlib warns about missing glyphs or renders boxes
records.evidence: Chinese axis labels rendered without tofu glyphs.

records.title: Credentialed CORS needs an explicit origin
records.lesson: Return a specific allowed origin when browser requests include credentials.
applicability: Cookies or authorization credentials are sent cross-origin
records.evidence: The browser accepted the response after replacing the wildcard origin.

records.title: Single-flight OAuth token refresh
records.lesson: Share one in-flight refresh operation among concurrent requests, then replay them once.
applicability: Many requests receive an expired-token response simultaneously
records.evidence: Concurrent expiry tests issued exactly one refresh call.

records.title: Honor Retry-After with bounded jitter
records.lesson: For rate limits, honor the server Retry-After value and add bounded jitter.
applicability: The service returns HTTP 429 under burst traffic
records.evidence: Load tests recovered without synchronized retry bursts.

records.title: Keep CI installs frozen to the lockfile
records.lesson: Use the package manager's frozen or clean-install mode in continuous integration.
applicability: Dependency resolution differs between developer machines and CI
records.evidence: CI stopped silently rewriting dependency versions.

records.title: Enable WAL for SQLite read concurrency
records.lesson: Use write-ahead logging when local workloads need readers during writes, then keep write transactions short.
applicability: Readers frequently block behind a local SQLite writer
records.evidence: The test workload eliminated reader lock timeouts.

records.title: Treat Excel serial dates explicitly
records.lesson: Detect numeric spreadsheet date columns and convert them with the workbook date system.
applicability: Dates arrive as values such as 45292 instead of formatted text
records.evidence: Fixture dates matched the workbook display after explicit conversion.

records.title: Separate Kubernetes startup and liveness probes
records.lesson: Use a startup probe for slow initialization so liveness checks do not restart a healthy boot.
applicability: A pod is repeatedly killed before a slow service finishes booting
records.evidence: The deployment completed startup without a restart loop.

records.title: Ignore reproducible generated artifacts
records.lesson: Keep reproducible build output out of version control and document its generation command.
applicability: Generated artifacts create noisy diffs and can be rebuilt deterministically
records.evidence: Review diffs contained only source changes after updating ignore rules.
